rule: Scripted opening ladder: stage 0 portal ring (12 s no-input lock, 23 s window, starter pick with forced default if idle, which also picks the region), stage 1 picking (20 s) then a fixed winnable 2-foe PvE fight (two Magikarp, 30 HP, Atk 1, SPLASH), each PvE stage gives loot (stage 1 one random component with a 1 in 40 shiny roll, stage 2 pick 1 of 3 unclaimed components, stage 3 one unclaimed component). Account XP and boosters are gated to games that reach stage 10 with 2 or more players (this gate is the main drop-off risk). Booster = 10 cards, last card from unique or legendary pool, duplicates converted to dust.
keep: A visible choice ring before any control, with a short no-input look window.
Forced default pick when the player does not choose (no dead screen).
A fixed, winnable first fight with a rare-variant roll on it.
Three starting boosters before any play; duplicates become dust so no pack is dead.
Stage-0 pick also sets the region (the first pick has two consequences).
change: Do not gate the first XP and first level behind a late stage (donor gates XP at stage 10 and 2 or more players; Frankendom should award the first level on the first win).
Show the reward reveal and level-up in the same beat; donor's level-up is a notification modal only (layout not read).
Use Frankendom zone data and Pit roster for the ring and first fight; no per-zone script.
look_test: Static HTML page at 375 wide, no server: screen 1 three doors on a ring with a 12 s locked countdown; screen 2 a door is auto-picked if untapped at 23 s; screen 3 a two-foe fight card with a fixed result; screen 4 one loot card with a 1 in 40 shiny sparkle. Compare locked 12 s vs instant control, forced default vs free wait, first XP on win vs first XP at stage 10.
